title: Copper Rail
description: Use copper ingots to craft rails!
body:
Java 1.21.9 Update(Copper Age) made copper more useful.

Want to make copper better? Add this pack to craft rails with copper.

It's easy. You only have to use **copper** instead of **iron**.

For example:

![How to craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d7467fa23543ad5b25112dbcbb6426059b4a3f7.png)

This data pack is **vanilla-friendly**.

Neither Optfine nor Iris is required.
